Name: (Content Patcher) Spouse Rooms Redesigned
Author: RyukanoHi
Description:
[Update 10/6/2018] Getting around to Stardew Valley again, and so I'm updating this mod with the new designs from version 07 of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5564515]endermaryn[/url]'s mod. The old stuff will still be available (and should still work).

Just a Content Patcher version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/828]this mod[/url]﻿.

Just go over ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url] and follow the instructions to install Content Patcher, and then drop this in the Mod folder. Simple.




All I did was repack it for Content Patcher, all credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5564515]endermaryn[/url]﻿ for the redesigns.

Also, as always, thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]PathosChild[/url]﻿ for all his hard work on SMAPI and Content Patcher.
